access_note: Publisher open requests returned 403 for several papers. Verified claims use publisher-indexed primary text, including methods/table extracts; the university-hosted 2025 review was accessible. Unretrieved method details are explicitly unknown, not attributed to S1. No private weather, harvest, or model scores were used.

sources.TITLE: Predicting Flower Phenology and Viability of Highbush Blueberry
sources.CULTIVAR: Five common cultivars; individual list not verified in accessed primary extract
sources.TARGET_STAGE: Flower development, bloom and flower viability
sources.DIRECT_APPLICABILITY: Supports threshold-range precedent for highbush flowering, not this exact rolling formula
sources.LIMITATION: Flower timing is not daily harvest; field/greenhouse and cultivar context matters.

sources.TITLE: Fruit Development Period of Several Southern Highbush Blueberry Cultivars
sources.CULTIVAR: Camellia, Emerald, O'Neal, Rebel, Southern Splendour, Star, Suziblue
sources.UPPER_CAP_C: Not stated in accessed methods; absence is not a universal no-cap recommendation
sources.FORMULA: ((Tmax + max(Tmin,7))/2) - 7; source raises Tmin to base before averaging
sources.VERIFICATION_SCOPE: Publisher-indexed methods p251 and abstract p249; reconciled S016/M012
sources.LIMITATION: Multi-location cultivar variation persists. Different clipping rule and phenological anchor; not an exact replication of S1.

sources.TITLE: A Methodology for Determining Suitable Heat-unit Requirements for Harvest of Highbush Blueberry
sources.AUTHORS: J. D. Carlson; J. F. Hancock Jr.
sources.CULTIVAR: 13 Michigan cultivars; individual list not verified in accessed primary extract
sources.GDD_BASE_C: Cultivar-specific evaluated lower thresholds, not one transferable base
sources.UPPER_CAP_C: Evaluated high-threshold choices; exact values not verified from accessed publisher extract
sources.FORMULA: Daily Tmax/Tmin heat-unit methods; complete calculation algorithm not verified in accessed extract
sources.VERIFICATION_SCOPE: Publisher-indexed abstract p774; printed year 1991 takes precedence over inconsistent aggregator year
sources.DIRECT_APPLICABILITY: Supports thermal-time utility and parameter/start-date dependence
sources.LIMITATION: Its 72-combination optimization is historical study methodology, explicitly NOT authorized for V0.13.

sources.TITLE: Container Production of Southern Highbush Blueberries Using High Tunnels
sources.CULTIVAR: 10 SHB cultivars; abstract includes Emerald, Farthing, Gupton, Meadowlark, Pearl, Rebel, Star, Sweetcrisp (not a complete list)
sources.TARGET_STAGE: Production timing, first/peak harvest; high-tunnel versus outdoor heat exposure
sources.FORMULA: Monthly GDD = (monthly average temperature - 7) * days in month
sources.ACCUMULATION_START: Calendar-month exposure; table spans Jan2016-Jun2017, not bloom-anchored
sources.VERIFICATION_SCOPE: Publisher-indexed abstract p267 and Table1 calculation footnote
sources.DIRECT_APPLICABILITY: Independent SHB production usage of 7 C
sources.LIMITATION: Monthly approximation and high-tunnel conditions do not validate the S1 daily formula or business cultivars.

sources.TITLE: Base and upper temperature thresholds to support the calculation of growing degree days aiming at their use with the FAO56rev crop coefficients curve: A review
sources.CULTIVAR: Various highbush; rabbiteye not reported in Table12
sources.UPPER_CAP_C: Not reported for these blueberry entries
sources.FORMULA: Review of heterogeneous original methods; not an independent S1 formula validation
sources.VERIFICATION_SCOPE: Accessible university-hosted journal PDF, section3.4.2 and Table12 p15
sources.DIRECT_APPLICABILITY: Modern synthesis corroborates contextual thresholds and missing upper-threshold authority
sources.LIMITATION: Secondary synthesis, not independent new blueberry experimental evidence; neither averages thresholds nor licenses cross-type parameter substitution.
